title: status
description: The bridge's answer to POST /tweaks/:n/status and POST /tweaks/:n/undone: the tweak's status now. The CLI prints tweak <n>: <status>, or with undo, tweak <n>: undone or tweak <n>: undo declined, change kept.

undo.description: What became of an undo asked of the finished tweak: declined (tweak decline, the change kept) or undone (tweak undone).
